# BONIRA — AP/AR Write-off Policy Specification

Governed by `PD-015` and `PD-030`.

V1 SHOULD / NON-BLOCKING.

Write-off is a first-class auditable occurrence and never deletes the source Obligation/history.

Manual proposal requires source Obligation identity/version, proposed effect, reason/comment, audit identity and evidence where governed.

No automatic threshold/materiality rule is defined. Approval is required and comes from approved workflow assignment/permission, not job title.

Accounting recognition follows the Recognition Owner Matrix. Reversal/correction creates a new governed occurrence and preserves history.

`UNSPECIFIED WRITE-OFF POLICY — MANUAL/HELD, DO NOT INVENT`

BONIRA_REQUIRED_SPECIFICATION_COMPLETION.Purpose: Assign one recognition owner per occurrence

BONIRA_FINAL_PRODUCT_DECISION_REGISTER.m.PD-015:
### `PD-015` — Governed AP/AR Write-off

**Domain:** AP/AR  
**Accepted option / disposition:** Option B — Governed Write-off  
**V1 position:** V1 SHOULD HAVE / NON-BLOCKING  
**Status:** `FROZEN`

**Decision statement:** Write-off is an auditable Economic Occurrence with eligibility, reason, approval, source identity, recognition policy, audit trail and correction/reversal path; source obligation/history is never erased.

**Production / evidence boundary:** Recognition follows PD-030; unspecified policy is held/manual.

**Source provenance:** `PD-015`  
**Affected Integration / governing links:** PD-030  
**Affected PDM:** —  
**Affected Journeys:** Write-off journeys

**Guardrail / fail-closed rule:** UNSPECIFIED WRITE-OFF POLICY — MANUAL/HELD, DO NOT INVENT
BONIRA_FINAL_PRODUCT_DECISION_REGISTER.m.PD-030:
### `PD-030` — Source-family Accounting Recognition Owner Matrix

**Domain:** Accounting / Cross-domain  
**Accepted option / disposition:** Promoted from DTR-PD-007 — Option B  
**V1 position:** BLOCKS V1  
**Status:** `FROZEN`

**Decision statement:** For every Source Family + Economic Occurrence exactly one domain owns Accounting Recognition. All postings require Source Identity, Source Version and Recognition Type; control-account reconciliation is mandatory; unspecified occurrences fail closed.

**Production / evidence boundary:** Requires BONIRA_ACCOUNTING_RECOGNITION_OWNER_MATRIX before implementation.

**Source provenance:** `DTR-PD-007`  
**Affected Integration / governing links:** DTR-INT-002; governs PD-008/009/011/012/014  
**Affected PDM:** —  
**Affected Journeys:** DTR-JNY-013

**Guardrail / fail-closed rule:** UNSPECIFIED RECOGNITION POLICY — STOP; DO NOT INFER
